newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita sees profits up 36% in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita sees profits up 36% in 96/97.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday that it expects its parent current profit to rise 36 percent to about 140 billion yen in the 1996/97 business year.

Meanwhile, parent sales are expected to reach 4.7 trillion yen in the current business year ending on March 31, up six percent from the previous year and about 100 billion yen more than the previous forecast, a company spokesman said.

The spokesman said that the company's earnings were buoyed by robust sales in its information and industrial machinery divisions, which include mobile communications equipment and personal computer peripherals.
He also said that a rise in sales in the audiovisual equipment division also contributed to the company's higher earnings.
